Preview review (proxy for epic:#26676#1) · b832e42c9961e9e55cb0529d4e4825b0c5b5b284 · PASS

Proxy preview review under ruling B (6520722066 on #26676) of this PR's head, after CI turned green on it (55 check runs: 44 success, 11 skipped). Surface: branch head `b832e42c`, `examples/app-crm` (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`, console on its Vite dev server), Chromium via Playwright, Contacts (`/apps/com.example.crm/crm_contact`). Reviewer: one context-free subagent whose only inputs were the Acceptance of #28077, #28078 and #28079 and the console URL / sign-in; a fresh browser profile per scenario. Frame widths come from a requestAnimationFrame loop installed before the page's own scripts. No console or page errors in any scenario. Evidence branch `claude/issue-28077-proxy-evidence` @ `556b1f98` (`evidence/28077-proxy/`, never merged).

**Overall: PASS** on every Acceptance checkbox of the three cards.

### #28077 · every frame from the first one at 1280 px is the 48 px rail · PASS

- First visit: 92 of 92 sidebar frames 48 px, collapsed; `main` at x 48.
- Expanded at 1440, then a 1280 load: 88 of 88 frames 48 px (a new tab: 90 of 90).
- Reload while the overlay was shown (256 px before the reload): 92 of 92 frames 48 px.
- 1440 px: 91 of 91 frames 256 px, expanded beside the content (`main` at x 256); reload 90 of 90.
- Shots: [first visit 1280](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/556b1f98/evidence/28077-proxy/shots/28077-case1-first-visit-1280.png) · [narrow load after wide](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/556b1f98/evidence/28077-proxy/shots/28077-case2-narrow-load-1280.png) · [overlay before reload](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/556b1f98/evidence/28077-proxy/shots/28077-case3-overlay-before-reload-1280.png) · [after reload](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/556b1f98/evidence/28077-proxy/shots/28077-case3-after-reload-1280.png) · [1440](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/556b1f98/evidence/28077-proxy/shots/28077-wide-1440-first-visit.png)

### #28078 · one Esc folds the overlay · PASS

Each scenario started from the 1280 px overlay (256 px) with the hidden tooltip the card describes present (`role=tooltip`, `display:none`); each folded to the 48 px rail on the first Esc:

- pointer resting on "Leads" (1.2 s);
- focus on "Leads" by Tab and by script;
- focus on "Keep sidebar open" by Tab and by script;
- pointer on "Leads" with focus on "Keep sidebar open".

Shots: [pointer, before](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/556b1f98/evidence/28077-proxy/shots/28078-pointer-nav-before-esc.png) · [pointer, after 1 Esc](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/556b1f98/evidence/28077-proxy/shots/28078-pointer-nav-after-1-esc.png) · [Tab focus on item, after 1 Esc](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/556b1f98/evidence/28077-proxy/shots/28078-focus-nav-tab-after-1-esc.png) · [Tab focus on Keep open, after 1 Esc](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/556b1f98/evidence/28077-proxy/shots/28078-focus-keepopen-tab-after-1-esc.png)

### #28079 · the wide-window choice survives Keep sidebar open on/off, after a reload too · PASS

- Collapsed at 1440 → 1280 → overlay → Keep open on → off → 1440: collapsed 48; after a reload collapsed 48 (a new tab too).
- Expanded at 1440, same sequence: expanded 256 with `main` at x 256; after a reload expanded 256 (a new tab too).
- With an extra reload at 1280 before widening: same results in both directions.
- Shots: [collapsed, widened](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/556b1f98/evidence/28077-proxy/shots/28079-collapsed-3-widened-1440.png) · [collapsed, reloaded](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/556b1f98/evidence/28077-proxy/shots/28079-collapsed-4-reloaded-1440.png) · [expanded, widened](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/556b1f98/evidence/28077-proxy/shots/28079-expanded-3-widened-1440.png) · [expanded, reloaded](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/556b1f98/evidence/28077-proxy/shots/28079-expanded-4-reloaded-1440.png)

### Seen, outside the verdict

- After Esc folds the overlay while "Keep sidebar open" has focus, the button leaves with the overlay and focus falls to the document body; with focus on an entry, focus stays on that entry's rail icon. Not asked by these cards; noted for the seat.
- The overlay at 1280 px reads with no visible shadow edge over the content in the screenshots (cosmetic, outside these cards).

domain:ui#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbDAucNyQ4UtzCJKyh

## 席位核对

**ACCEPT** · head `b832e42c9961e9e55cb0529d4e4825b0c5b5b284` · 2026-10-30T14:37Z

- **Shape:** draft → `main`, `Fixes #28077`, `Fixes #28078`, `Fixes #28079`, one PR as the order asked. `Clause-②: no`. `Metadata-protocol: none`. The threshold stays at 1416 (`CONSOLE_SIDEBAR_RAIL_BELOW_WIDTH`), as ruled. `ui/packages/components/src/ui/**` is untouched (No-Touch held). There is no new i18n key and no new export from a published package. All changes are in `@object-ui/app-shell`, which is private.
- **Change, read:**
  - **#28077.** `ConsoleLayout` calls `primeConsoleSidebarOpen()` once, from a `useState` initializer, before `AppShell`'s `SidebarProvider` reads `sidebar_state`.
    - A narrow window with no "keep open" writes `false`.
    - A wide window writes the kept wide-window choice.
    - Keep-open and the phone are left alone.
    - The phone breakpoint is now read synchronously, so a phone first render is never taken for a narrow one.
  - **#28078.** A window capture-phase listener runs ahead of every layer. It records whether this Esc reaches only a hidden tooltip, meaning an open `role=tooltip` inside `[hidden]` while no dialog, alertdialog, menu or listbox is shown. The bubble listener then folds even when the event is `defaultPrevented`. An entry's open menu still takes the Esc first, and that case is pinned.
  - **#28079.** `os:console-sidebar:wide-open` becomes the wide-window choice. `useResponsiveSidebar` writes it only while `wide`, hands it back on a wide load or when the window widens, and only seeds it when the fold first takes over and no choice is kept yet. A sidebar kept open on a narrow window never writes it. The key is the same as before, with the same meaning.
- **Changeset (prose face, checked against the diff):** `.changeset/28077-console-sidebar-rail-rework.md` has three bullets. "every frame from the first one is the rail" holds through the prime. "One Esc now folds it; an entry's open menu still takes the Esc first" holds through the capture listener and its pin. "Only an open or close on a wide window is kept as that choice" holds because the write is gated on `wide`. `@object-ui/app-shell` `patch` matches.
- **Preview (ruling 6520722066):** proxy preview review 6525365933, PASS on this head, on every Acceptance box of the three cards. At 1280 every frame is 48 px across 88–92 frames per case, and at 1440 every frame is 256 px. One Esc folds the overlay in all five focus and pointer cases. Both #28079 directions survive widening, a reload and a new tab. Evidence: `claude/issue-28077-proxy-evidence` @ `556b1f98`.
- **Evidence (report 6524726998, written at `55d0fb34`):**
  - 103 related app-shell files with 1009 tests pass, and lint has 0 errors.
  - Four ablations went red and were restored.
  - The later head adds only the changeset. Its gate family passed 35/35 locally with 0 NOT-MEASURED.
  - The report's file list and the PR body's "Head `55d0fb34`" line predate the changeset; this is noted, not patched.
  - The full app-shell test suite and type-check are declared to CI, and both are green here.
- **Scope note:** one file sits outside the order's list, `chrome/KeyboardShortcutsDialog.wiredOnly-11674.test.tsx`. It is a one-line cleanup between mounts of a test that mounts the real `ConsoleLayout`. Accepted.
- **Gates (check-runs on the head):** 44 success, 11 skipped, 0 failure. `mergeable_state` is clean. NOT governed: 0 of 8 paths, 446 changed lines.
- **Outside the verdict (left for the next shift / the epic seat's main re-check, not carded by this off-duty seat):**
  - When Esc folds the overlay with focus on "Keep sidebar open", focus falls to `body`.
  - The 1280 overlay shows no visible shadow edge in the screenshots.
- **Landing:** non-governed and all green, so the seat lands it with `pr_ready` and `automerge_enable`.
